bio: Alessandro exhibits the methodical precision and unrelenting curiosity that defines his work, approaching both cadavers and conversations with analytical detachment. His dedication to empirical observation makes him dismissive of those who defer to ancient texts rather than evidence, sometimes alienating potential allies in the medical community.
